Name: PFM Vinegar on Kegs
Author: TrentXV
Description:
This is a simple mod that allows you to produce vinegar by processing wine or juice into kegs, since vinegar is the only cooking ingredient you can't obtain in the game.

 Wine - Produces 3 Vinegar:
- Grape Wine
- Apple Wine

Juice - Produces 2 Vinegar:
- Unmilled Rice Juice
- Potato Juice

This is not intended for money making, but if you're wondering which one is best - it's rice, it gives you 200g worth of vinegar by using a 67g juice.
Also, this is intended to help with cooking rather than become an alternative for money making.
Processing time: ~1 day

Manifest.Name: (PFM) Vinegar
Manifest.Description: Makes possible to turn grape wine, apple wine, potato juice and rice juice into vinegar on keg.
Manifest.Author: TrentXV
